data_description.k: Per-gate residual (z-score) a gate must reach to count as hot. Lower is more sensitive, higher cuts more false positives.
data_description.baseline_window_hours: How much history the rolling noise baseline covers. Longer windows adapt more slowly but resist being skewed by one long occupied period.
data_description.enter_score: Combined score needed to flip from vacant to occupied.
data_description.exit_score: Combined score that must be sustained under for the hold timer to run out and flip back to vacant. Kept below the enter score to avoid flapping.
data_description.hold_seconds: How long the score must stay under the exit score, continuously, before occupancy clears.
data_description.freeze_hold_seconds: How long baseline adaptation stays paused after occupancy clears, so a person's lingering thermal/RF signature doesn't get learned into the noise floor.
data_description.support_tau_s: Time constant of the neighbour-elevation smoothing used to rescue a single hot gate next to a mildly elevated neighbour. Larger values smooth over more noise but react more slowly.
